---
description: How the tools for a fight are called - fight_start, fight_round, fight_read and fight_end. It says how to call them, not when. Delete this file and an agent that finds one of them by search is given no such guide.
---
fight_start names the two sides: `with`, those who fight on the player's side (name the player's character too if they fight), and `foes`, each by name or id. A fight is exactly the people named: nobody joins by themselves. `at` is the place it is at (left out, where they all stand), `order` is the initiative order if you have one, and `roll_initiative` true has it rolled. Several fights can be on at once, each with an id at its place; a start that names a fight under way, by `fight` or by its place, adds the people named to it. fight_round records a round as the story decided it: `actions` in the order they happened, each with `who`, what they `did`, `to` whom, the `result` in words and the `roll` that decided it by its id (roll rolls; this tool rolls nothing); `fight` where several are on. fight_read takes `fight` to read one fight and nothing to read every fight under way. fight_end takes `fight` (needed when several are on), `winner` (`party`, the `with` side, or `foes`) and `break_off` true to end it with no winner.

The world's rules that hear a fight start, take someone in or end are listed in the answer, not run. A fighter who is not there, or cannot fight by the world's rules, is in the fight all the same and the answer reports it; so is one who acts twice in a round, out of the order or beyond reach on the map. On a grid that counts rounds, the rounds fight_round plays move the clock. Each write also takes `source`, and `precision` and `standing` where you know them.

    tool_use {"name": "fight_start", "args": {"with": ["Mara", "Wren"], "foes": ["Grey wolf"], "at": "Old mill", "source": {"from": "prose", "message": "m-12"}}}
    tool_use {"name": "fight_round", "args": {"actions": [{"who": "Mara", "did": "swings her axe", "to": "Grey wolf", "result": "hit, 6 damage", "roll": "r-14"}, {"who": "Grey wolf", "did": "lunges", "to": "Wren", "result": "a miss"}], "source": {"from": "prose", "message": "m-13"}}}
    tool_use {"name": "fight_end", "args": {"winner": "party", "source": {"from": "prose", "message": "m-15"}}}
